title: Keratins coordinate tissue spreading by balancing spreading forces with tissue material properties

comments: Elegant combination of in vivo imaging, genetic interference, rheology, and computational modeling; the dual mechanosensitive roles of keratins in both force generation and material resilience provide a parsimonious explanation for tissue spreading mechanics.

title: The four voltage-sensing domains of T-type calcium channels activate near the resting membrane potential

comments: Elegant application of voltage-clamp fluorometry resolves a classic biophysical conundrum; methodological caveat regarding La3+ artifacts highlights potential reinterpretation of prior gating-current literature, though mechanistic explanation for VSD-pore coupling remains incomplete.

model_io.model: Voltage-clamp fluorometry on human CaV3.1 channels

hypotheses.hypothesis: All four VSDs activate before pore opening, opposite to traditional gating-current predictions

hypotheses.hypothesis: La3+ confounds traditional gating-current measurements of VSD activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; La3+ artifacts clarified, explaining discrepancies between gating-current and fluorometry data
